releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
### Fixed

- **Bookmarks now hide entries whose file was deleted.** Obsidian keeps the entry and its own bookmarks pane hides it; this block did not. A vault with a long history could show a list where every row led nowhere.
- **Bookmarks show your most recent ones** when you have more than fit, instead of the oldest.
- **A Home tab reopened at startup now loads correctly.** Obsidian restores views before the vault index is ready, so bookmarks fell back to raw paths with `.md` and were unclickable, and an image logo or quote file could silently fail to load. The page re-renders once files resolve, and rows resolve their file on click and hover rather than at render time.

releases.description:
Settings are rebuilt on Obsidian's declarative settings API.

**Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.** Previous releases support 1.11+.

### Added

- **Settings are searchable.** Every setting now appears in Obsidian's own settings search, so you can find "quote file" or "search delay" without knowing which page it lives on.
- **File and folder pickers** replace typed-out paths for the logo image, quote file, new-page folder, and file/folder button targets.
- **Native list handling for buttons** — reordering, deletion and the add affordance now come from Obsidian instead of hand-rolled arrow buttons.

### Changed

- Settings are organised as five pages rather than custom tabs, matching how Obsidian presents its own settings.
- Conditional settings appear and disappear without rebuilding the whole tab. This also removes, structurally, the class of bug where a re-render could steal focus from the field you were typing into.

### Why now

Obsidian is steering plugin developers to this API and has deprecated the old one. Migrating now is a single move rather than a migration plus a later deprecation scramble.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
Fixes a regression introduced in 1.0.1.

### Fixed

- **Compatibility with Obsidian 1.11–1.12.** 1.0.1 called `setDestructive()`, which only exists from 1.13.0, while the plugin declares support for 1.11.0. Reverted to the deprecated-but-present `setWarning()`.
- **Type safety around date formatting.** Obsidian re-exports `moment` as a namespace type, which loses its call signature and made every `moment()` call resolve to `any`. Narrowed at the import. Type-only — the built output is unchanged.
- **Settings wording** now follows Obsidian's sentence-case style guide.

### Added

- A "What it accesses, and why" section in the README covering file enumeration, note reading, and the fact that nothing leaves your vault.
- `eslint-plugin-obsidianmd` in the dev toolchain, so API-compatibility problems are caught before release rather than at review.

**Requires Obsidian 1.11.0 or later.**
